You're making solid progress with the butterfly twist! Right now, the main thing holding you back from that fast twist and horizontal position is your body alignment during the jump. Your upper body is slightly tilted, which can slow down your rotation and affect your balance in the air.

This matters because achieving a perfectly horizontal position is key to maximizing your speed and control. When your body isn't aligned, it creates drag and makes it harder to maintain momentum throughout the twist.

To really nail this move, it's crucial to focus on holistic strength and comprehensive training. A single tip or a photo can't replace the value of real-time feedback. Working with a coach in person can help you fine-tune your form, catch those subtle adjustments, and build a training plan that suits your needs.
